name: Blind Love
source:
As a troll finding dinner can be hard, but finding a date/life partner can be harder!  Theodore has decided to take his chances on Blind Love, a dating game show! But will the real reason he's there ruin it all?

[From [url=https://teharra-rose.itch.io/blind-love]Itch.io[/url]]
